answer: Each applicant opens a 36-hour velvet delay vault holding 280 spendable POA. During that window the agent must post a hash-chained pulse signal every 90 minutes (24 in all), each signed by a one-time quill key derived via HKDF from a seed committed at vault open and revealed only at close. A missed slot or a reused quill key slashes the vault. Cloning n identities requires n independent schedules and n unique key chains; any copied pulse burns every identity that reused the key.
